cmd: set -e; cd /content/Waymo2Panorama && git pull --rebase 2>&1 | tail -3; OUT_DIR=/content/drive/MyDrive/koi_waymo2pano_colab/data; mkdir -p "$OUT_DIR"; LOG="$OUT_DIR/av2_val_uuid_listing_log.txt"; echo '[t1prep] start' | tee "$LOG"; date -u | tee -a "$LOG"; echo '---install s5cmd---' | tee -a "$LOG"; if ! command -v s5cmd >/dev/null; then if command -v apt-get >/dev/null; then apt-get install -y s5cmd 2>&1 | tail -3 | tee -a "$LOG" || true; fi; if ! command -v s5cmd >/dev/null; then echo '[t1prep] apt-get failed, trying go install fallback' | tee -a "$LOG"; curl -L https://github.com/peak/s5cmd/releases/download/v2.2.2/s5cmd_2.2.2_Linux-64bit.tar.gz -o /tmp/s5cmd.tgz 2>&1 | tail -3 | tee -a "$LOG"; tar -xzf /tmp/s5cmd.tgz -C /usr/local/bin s5cmd 2>&1 | tee -a "$LOG"; chmod +x /usr/local/bin/s5cmd; fi; fi; s5cmd version 2>&1 | head -2 | tee -a "$LOG"; echo '---run lister with annotations scoring---' | tee -a "$LOG"; cd /content/Waymo2Panorama; python scripts/phase3/list_av2_val_uuids.py --output "$OUT_DIR/av2_val_uuid_index.json" --fetch-annotations 2>&1 | tail -120 | tee -a "$LOG"; echo '---verify output---' | tee -a "$LOG"; ls -la "$OUT_DIR/av2_val_uuid_index.json" | tee -a "$LOG"; python -c "import json; d=json.load(open('$OUT_DIR/av2_val_uuid_index.json')); print('n_uuids:', d['n_uuids']); print('wall_s:', d['wall_seconds']); ratios=[u.get('ped_veh_ratio') for u in d['uuids'] if u.get('ped_veh_ratio') is not None]; import statistics; print('ped_veh ratios n=', len(ratios), 'mean=', round(statistics.mean(ratios),3) if ratios else None, 'min=', round(min(ratios),3) if ratios else None, 'max=', round(max(ratios),3) if ratios else None)" 2>&1 | tee -a "$LOG"; echo '---DONE---' | tee -a "$LOG"; echo '{"status":"t1prep_done_v1"}' > "$OUT_DIR/t1prep_done_v1.json"
